versions.content: At SoAd_TcpAccepted(), SoAd shall perform the following actions if the TCP SoAd SocketConnectionGroup related to SocketId has both SoAdSocketTcpInitiate and SoAdSocketMsgAcceptanceFilterEnabled set to FALSE and is not online (i.e. current connection state not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE): (1) assign the TcpIp socket used for the established connect ion and provided as parameter SocketIdConnected to the socket connection and (2) change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE and return E_OK .
